hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo 'SessionStart re-check, run before NEXT.md is read:' && { GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch -q origin || echo 'git fetch failed: the counts below are against the last fetch'; } && git status -sb && echo "behind, unpushed: $(git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main)" && grep -m1 '^Updated' NEXT.md
